text:
alex: Heads-up — PM1 postmortem action item #3 (fix KV eviction config) is 10 days overdue. Owner listed as @maria. Can we get an ETA?

maria: Sorry, been swamped — still blocked waiting on infra access. I pinged infra yesterday.

alex: @infra-bot Can you confirm the status of the access request? Link to postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1023

infra-bot: Access request INF-432 assigned to lee (eng-infra).

lee: Working on it, should be done EOD tomorrow.

sam: Quick reminder — this remediation is tied to the recurring tail-latency incidents. Need it done before the next deploy.

alex: If we don't have progress by Friday I'm escalating to @tara (eng-ops).

maria: If infra can't unblock, I'm ok moving owner to @sam.

lee: Update: infra patch deployed to staging, Maria should have access now.

maria: Confirmed, I can run the config change tonight. ETA tomorrow morning.

alex: Thanks. @oncall-bot can you add a follow-up reminder for 24h?

oncall-bot: Reminder set for 24h.

tara: Thanks everyone. Please add a brief runbook note in the postmortem before closing.

maria: Done — added runbook snippet and closure notes:
```
Runbook: If KV eviction causes tail-latency, rollback to previous eviction threshold and alert eng-infra.
Change applied: KV eviction lower bound set to 0.2s for 512B items.
Verification steps: monitor 95th/99th tail for 2 deploy windows.
```

alex: Marking as resolved in the PM tracker. Closing the action item.

oncall-bot: Action item #PM1-3 marked CLOSED by alex.

sam: :tada: great! Also adding to recurring-incidents spreadsheet.

alex: Closing thread — thanks all.
